Science, communication and digital strategy for complex ideas.

I’m Ryan Laird: an astrophysicist, communicator and strategist working across space, sustainability and technology.

I help organisations and individuals explain difficult science clearly and accurately, through strategy, writing, teaching and mentoring. Based in Leicester, working across the UK and Europe.

What I do

Four connected strands of work. Pick the one that matches what you need.

Strategy and communication

Positioning, content and digital strategy for organisations that handle technical, scientific or environmental subject matter.

Evidence: Led marketing for ESA Business Applications, delivered through HE Space.

See how I work with organisations

Research and writing

Publications, articles and commentary on space, climate, Earth observation and how science reaches the public.

Evidence: MPhys in Astrophysics, including research experience on cometary nuclei.

Read the research and writing

Teaching and mentoring

Tutoring, talks, workshops and one-to-one mentoring for students, teams and people changing direction.

Evidence: I run Leicester Space Week, a citywide space festival.

Digital systems and open work

Websites, data pipelines and small tools, built in the open where I can.
